content.short: Trail of Bits is a security research and audit firm known for deep blockchain reviews and widely used open source tools.
content.description: Trail of Bits is a security research company that performs blockchain assessments across smart contracts, bridges, nodes, DeFi systems, and offchain components. Its official service pages emphasize tailored reviews, early stage design assessment, invariant testing, and root cause analysis instead of checklist driven auditing. The firm is also widely known for publishing open source tools such as Slither and Echidna, which makes the listing relevant both for projects seeking a high end audit partner and for developers using its security tooling.
content.meta: Trail of Bits combines blockchain security reviews, technical research, and open source tools used across the Web3 ecosystem.

resources.title: Building Secure Uniswap v4 Hooks
resources.tldr: Hooks let anyone inject logic into a pool, which is the point and also why they break. Catalogues the mistakes that keep reappearing in shipped code.

resources.title: A Few Notes on AWS Nitro Enclaves and KMS Integration
resources.tldr: Very long and very specific on the risks of wiring an enclave to a key management service. Relevant to anyone putting signing keys inside a TEE.

resources.title: Mutation Testing Comes to DAML
resources.tldr: Mutation testing deliberately breaks your code to see whether the test suite notices. The clearest way to learn coverage and rigour are not the same.
